description: Explore, as an alternative way to cheapen group 1. Keep 3 convs in group 1 but narrow its width from 128 to 96 channels (96/384/768, or 96/384/576 on the incumbent if the 768 run isn't kept). The whitening conv output and the group-2 input adjust to match. Same epochs, LR rescaled only as airbench's width-independent scaling dictates (unchanged).
